Note for N-29 · from QA run #29002 (W4-C3b1, subject `7fa9873f`). ⛔ Not a claim.

Three more items fail today as stale spec against ADR-0146, for this card's re-measure list (item 1 of "Wanted"). The product follows the rulings; the clauses predate them. No card was filed for them, because this card owns the rewrite.

- `automation.packaged-flow-clone-contract` r10 · acceptance[1], [2], [6] (ADR-0146 D4, #28149). The clone lands in `com.example.showcase.custom` with `status: obsolete` and the switched-off notice; over 3 urgent task creates the base ran each time and the clone never ran (no double-fire, the specimen now proves the opposite); after a restart it is listed on `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/automations`, "In com.example.showcase.custom", and `~org` reads "No flows outside a package…". The clone body now takes `package`, and its refusal arms (read-only, not installed, outside the closure, blank) are unasked.
- `studio-authoring.packaged-automation-studio-lock` r6 · acceptance[0] (the New half) and [2] (ADR-0146 D3 #28572, D4 #28148). "New automation" is present on the read-only base and targets the pair; the header switch is the ledger switch (`data-testid=auto-ledger-switch`, `POST /api/v1/automation/:name/toggle` → 200, the definition unchanged). The lock itself holds (acceptance[1], [3], negative[0], [1] pass). knownGaps[1]'s 11124 pin mocks `_status` 404, so `AutomationsPillar.ledgerSwitch-28148.test.tsx` is the pin for the live shape. The new "Customize" affordance is unasked.
- `studio-authoring.access-permission-set-lifecycle` r4 · acceptance[3] (ADR-0146 D3, #28572). The read-only showcase package offers "New permission set"; saving calls `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization` (201) and then creates the set in `com.example.showcase.custom`. The packaged set's own controls are all disabled, and forged writes get 403 ITEM_LOCKED / 422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED.

Reproduction rules: R-1, R-2 and R-3 in #29002.

Run evidence for the `automation.setup-packaged-automation-board` re-point (QA run record #29124, W4-L1 live legs at 7fa9873f). The item r10 failed on A0, A1, A2, A3, A5 and A6 as a stale spec after #28785; A4 and A7 passed. Measured on the live replacements, so the rewrite can re-point most clauses rather than retire them:

- A0: `GET /api/v1/meta/app?id=setup` serves `nav_packaged_actions` (`automation:packaged-actions`); `nav_packaged_automation` occurs 0 times. The old URL `/component/automation/packaged` redirects to Studio › All metadata › Flow, so steps[2]'s typed-URL fallback no longer lands on any Setup page.
- A1: the Studio rail and `GET /api/v1/automation/_status` both list 32 flows.
- A2: Studio's `auto-ledger-switch` toggles a flow; the state persists across a reload and in the activation row.
- A3: the actions half holds on the Packaged actions page (no clone on actions).
- A5: the admin's 409 shows verbatim in Studio's `studio-refusal` strip, which has no `role=alert` (the retired page announced it). That gap is filed as #29139; the re-pointed clause needs that card's outcome. The member's 403 sentence is exact over the API.
- A6: Studio's `auto-new-similar-*` opens the New similar dialog, validates name and label, and shows the 400 sentence in `role=alert`.
- A7 now reads: a member is refused at both Setup and Studio, the activation read answers 403, and `_status` and `/meta/action` stay open.
